name: Xiao AI Technology Limited
summary: Xiao AI Technology Limited operates as a prefabricated food supply chain company. It provides central kitchen prefabricated dish supply chain and Intelligent robot restaurant services. The company was formerly known as SIPP International Industries, Inc. and changed its name to Xiao AI Technology Limited in February 2026. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Reno, Nevada. Xiao AI Technology Limited is a subsidiary of Chenxu International Investment Holding Group Limited.
